cases.name: keys-private-pkcs8-public-key-after-private-key-refused

cases.name: keys-private-pkcs8-stray-octet-refused
cases.note: One stray octet inside the PrivateKeyInfo after privateKey.

cases.name: keys-private-pkcs8-algorithm-without-curve-refused
cases.note: The AlgorithmIdentifier has no parameters; the inner ECPrivateKey names P-256.

cases.name: keys-private-pkcs8-algorithm-null-parameters-refused
cases.note: The AlgorithmIdentifier has NULL parameters; the inner ECPrivateKey names P-256.

cases.name: keys-private-pkcs8-inner-version-2-refused
cases.note: The ECPrivateKey inside the PrivateKeyInfo has version 2.

cases.name: keys-private-pkcs8-inner-p384-parameters-refused
cases.note: The ECPrivateKey inside a P-256 PrivateKeyInfo names P-384 in its [0] parameters.

cases.name: keys-private-pkcs8-inner-explicit-parameters-refused
cases.note: The ECPrivateKey inside the PrivateKeyInfo carries explicit parameters, not a named curve.

cases.name: keys-private-number-refused
cases.note: A loader that takes only bytes cannot be given a number and skips this case.

cases.name: keys-public-point-off-curve-refused
cases.note: partner's point with the lowest bit of Y flipped.

cases.name: keys-public-hybrid-point-refused
cases.note: partner's point in the hybrid form (06/07 prefix): only the uncompressed form is accepted.

cases.name: keys-public-unused-bits-declared-refused
cases.note: partner2's point in a BIT STRING whose first content octet declares one unused bit. Y ends in 0xc0, so the bit it declares unused is already zero: the point stays on the curve, and only that octet is wrong.

cases.name: keys-public-unused-bits-shifted-point-refused
cases.note: partner2's uncompressed point shifted left by one bit, in a BIT STRING that declares one unused bit. A loader that honours the unused-bit count and shifts the value back recovers partner2's point exactly, and must still refuse the key.

cases.name: keys-store-all-roles
cases.note: A single partner public key reads back as a list of one.

cases.name: keys-store-role-left-out
cases.note: partnerPrivateKey is not supplied: registration succeeds and that role's lookup fails.

cases.name: keys-store-null-roles-are-absent
cases.note: null means the role is left out: registration succeeds and each lookup fails with its role error.

cases.name: keys-store-unusable-key-in-list
cases.note: Registration refuses every unusable key, even next to a usable one; only a parser skips them.

cases.name: keys-store-empty-partner-before-keys
cases.note: The partner id is checked before any key.

cases.name: keys-store-public-keys-before-private-key
cases.note: Roles are checked in parameter order: the partner public keys before the partner private key.

cases.name: keys-store-private-key-before-boostx-key
cases.note: Roles are checked in parameter order: the partner private key before the BoostX public key.

cases.name: keys-store-lookup-exact-id
cases.note: Ids match byte for byte: no case folding or trimming.

cases.name: keys-emit-gamepass-claims
cases.note: The implicit builder checks pin the header {"alg":"ES256","typ":"JWT"} and canonical segments.

cases.name: keys-jws-leading-space-not-trimmed
cases.note: Tokens are used exactly as received: the space makes the header segment non-canonical.

cases.name: keys-jws-trailing-newline-not-trimmed
cases.note: The line feed lands in the signature segment, a signature failure.

cases.name: keys-header-other-members-ignored
cases.note: b64 without crit has no effect: the payload is still the base64url segment.

cases.name: keys-header-alg-escaped-value-accepted
cases.note: The value is compared after JSON unescaping.

cases.name: keys-header-alg-escaped-name-accepted
cases.note: Member names are compared after JSON unescaping.

cases.name: keys-header-alg-name-case-variants
cases.note: Names match exactly: neither member is alg, so alg is absent.

cases.name: keys-header-duplicate-alg-last-null
cases.note: A later null counts as null.

cases.name: keys-header-crit-null
cases.note: A crit member of any value, null included, is refused.

cases.name: keys-header-trailing-data
cases.note: Exactly one JSON value.

cases.name: keys-header-lone-surrogate
cases.note: The member is otherwise ignored, but the header text is malformed.

cases.name: keys-order-header-object-before-alg
cases.note: Not an object, no alg and an empty signature: the object check comes first.

cases.name: keys-order-signature-before-payload
cases.note: The payload is not JSON, but the signature is checked first.

cases.name: keys-order-payload-before-claims
cases.note: round is missing too, but the payload text is malformed first.

cases.name: keys-order-boostx-key-before-partner-keys
cases.note: Both keys fail with the same category; the order between them shows only in messages.

cases.name: keys-b64-payload-padded
cases.note: The signature covers the padded text, so only the payload encoding fails.

cases.name: keys-b64-static-payload-accepted
cases.note: The untransformed payload the b64-payload cases start from.

cases.name: keys-sig-zero
cases.note: r = s = 0 is a signature failure, not a key error.

cases.name: keys-sig-high-s-accepted
cases.note: A fixed token whose JWS signature has s > n/2; low-S is not required.

cases.name: keys-gid-sig-high-s-accepted
cases.note: The fixed gid signature with s replaced by n - s.

cases.name: keys-order-outer-signature-before-gid
cases.note: Both signatures are bad: the outer one is checked first, so invalid_gid is absent.

cases.name: keys-payload-duplicate-not-merged
cases.note: The later booster replaces the earlier one whole, so gid is missing.

cases.name: keys-payload-utf8-boundaries-accepted
cases.note: The smallest and largest well-formed sequences around each refused form.

cases.name: keys-payload-inner-feff-accepted
cases.note: U+FEFF is refused only as the first bytes.

cases.name: keys-surrogate-gid-bet-never-verified
cases.note: The GID signature covers the bytes JSON.stringify gives for the id, so only the lone-surrogate rule refuses it.

cases.name: keys-surrogate-high-then-escaped-backslash
cases.note: The text after the high surrogate is an escaped backslash followed by the letters udc00.

cases.name: keys-surrogate-escaped-backslash-accepted
cases.note: An escaped backslash followed by the letters ud800 is not an escape.

cases.name: keys-surrogate-in-replaced-duplicate
cases.note: The rule reads the text, so a member a later duplicate replaces still counts.

cases.name: keys-surrogate-verifykeys-iss
cases.note: shape, not iss-aud: the text is malformed before any claim is compared.

cases.name: keys-extract-ignores-trailing-newline
cases.note: The line feed lands in the signature segment, which extraction does not read.

cases.name: keys-parse-boostx-key-unusable
cases.note: The key error passes through: it is not wrapped as an invalid Booster.

cases.name: keys-parse-verifykeys-key-unusable
cases.note: The reason function maps an invalid public key to signature.

cases.name: keys-exp-now-refused
cases.note: exp <= now is refused, and stays refused as the clock moves on.

cases.name: keys-exp-fraction-accepted
cases.note: exp is a JSON number, not necessarily an integer.

cases.name: keys-exp-huge-accepted
cases.note: A number beyond binary64 range reads as +Infinity, which is after now.

cases.name: keys-nbf-now-accepted
cases.note: nbf <= now is accepted, and stays accepted as the clock moves on.

cases.name: keys-order-exp-before-gid
cases.note: The GID was signed by partner2, which is not listed: the claim step runs before GID verification.

cases.name: keys-iat-rounds-to-integer-accepted
cases.note: The text rounds to the binary64 value 1700000000, which is integral.

cases.name: keys-iat-rounds-past-max-safe
cases.note: Rounds to 2^53, beyond 2^53-1.

cases.name: keys-iat-overflow
cases.note: Beyond binary64 range: +Infinity, not an integer.

cases.name: keys-iat-underflow-accepted
cases.note: Underflows to 0, which is integral.

cases.name: keys-iat-zero-accepted
cases.note: No age check: any integral iat is accepted.

cases.name: keys-window-zero-is-default
cases.note: With a zero-second window this iat would be stale.

cases.name: keys-window-fraction-under-one
cases.note: A positive value under 1 s is a zero-second window, not the default.

cases.name: keys-window-nan
cases.note: A runner that cannot pass NaN as a duration skips this case.

cases.name: keys-order-window-before-token
cases.note: An invalid window is a configuration error, reported before the token is read.

cases.name: keys-handler-header-read-after-lookup
cases.note: Extraction does not read the header, so the keys are looked up and the parse then refuses alg.

cases.name: keys-handler-unknown-partner-quoted
cases.note: The id is quoted; how the quote inside it is escaped is free.

cases.name: keys-handler-boostx-lookup-failure-decides
cases.note: Both lookups fail; the BoostX key lookup decides (500), not the unknown partner (400).

cases.name: keys-handler-key-before-bad-signature
cases.note: The token is forged and the store key unusable: the key error comes first, so 500 rather than 400.

cases.name: keys-handler-verifykeys-store-key-unusable
cases.note: A handler answers a key error with 500 and never sends the signature reason for it.

cases.name: keys-client-lookup-before-params
cases.note: The key is looked up by params.partner before the parameters are validated.

cases.name: keys-client-lookup-inside-time-limit
cases.note: The per-attempt time limit covers the key-store lookup.
